attribution_policy.deli_public: Deli upstream protocol has no standard license identified in the local PROVENANCE. No full original protocol or HTML snapshot copied; independent method synthesis only.
attribution_policy.deli_local: User-local additions and their actual source hashes are identified separately from the public Deli protocol. The six local helper/test sources retain their original hashes; the adapted venue_profile.py is marked copied_verbatim=false with its destination hash and adaptation, while the remaining five stay verbatim; knowledge files are independent method synthesis. The checkpoint ledger is not copied. The two user-local academic-prose guides are also copied with exact hashes; the writing/review contexts load the full principles and chosen E01–E14 cases progressively.
attribution_policy.paperflow_local: The content snapshot includes uncommitted changes; HEAD alone does not identify it. Only methods/contract shapes are adapted.
attribution_policy.llm_wiki: Wiki pages are local summaries/inferences with explicit empirical boundaries. No claim of reproducing the cited papers or deploying their frameworks.
